title: Quiz 1 — Physics in Real Life & Motion

questions.text: Which area of daily life is MOST improved by understanding motion and forces?
Which of the following BEST describes translational motion?
options: An object moves from one point to another without rotating
An object spins around a fixed axis
questions.correct: An object moves from one point to another without rotating

questions.text: Which of the following is an example of PURELY rotational motion?
options: A spinning top on a table
questions.correct: A spinning top on a table

questions.text: Which quantity is measured in rad/s?
In the equation v = r × ω, what does 'r' represent?
options: The radius (distance from the axis of rotation)
The total mass of the object
questions.correct: The radius (distance from the axis of rotation)

questions.text: A wheel of radius 0.5 m rotates with angular velocity 4 rad/s. What is the linear velocity of a point on the rim?
Why does the tip of a windmill blade move faster than the base?
options: Because points farther from the axis have greater linear velocity (v = r × ω)
Because the tip has less friction
questions.correct: Because points farther from the axis have greater linear velocity (v = r × ω)

questions.text: Which physical quantity determines the pitch of a sound?

Which of the following is NOT a way physics improves daily life?
Which of the following best represents a lever in action?
options: A ramp loading boxes onto a truck
A flag being raised on a flagpole

questions.text: What type of quantity is angular displacement measured in?
